CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS  Tuesday, March 19, 2024
CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  Special Meeting, 6:30 PM

Dandy De Paula, Mayor Pro Tem
Maria Teresa Del Rio, Councilmember  Ernesto Marquez,City Manager

  Victor Farfan, Mayor

  MINUTES
CALL TO ORDER

The City Council Special Meeting was called to order on Tuesday, March 19, 2024 at 6:31 PM.

FLAG SALUTE

The flag salute was led by Mayor Farfan.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT
  Councilmember Del Rio
  Councilmember Roa
  Councilmember Vargas
  Mayor Pro Tem De Paula
  Mayor Farfan
ABSENT
  None

Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, announced a quorum.

PUBLIC COMMENTS ­ GENERAL OR ITEMS ON OR OFF THE AGENDA

There were no Public Comments.

AGENDA ORGANIZATION

There were no changes to the agenda organization.

DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

1.  Recommendation to discuss and consider approving a donation to Artesia High School.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, provided the staff report.

  Councilmember Vargas spoke.

  Councilmember Roa spoke.

  Councilmember
  CITY COUNCIL  Del Rio spoke.

  A motion was made by Mayor Pro Tem De Paula, seconded by Councilmember Del Rio, to
  approve a donation of $3,000 to the Artesia High School Girls Soccer Team.
   SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, provided the staff report.

  Councilmember Vargas spoke.

  Councilmember Roa spoke.

  Councilmember Del Rio spoke.

  Mayor Pro Tem De Paula spoke.

  A motion was made by Mayor Pro Tem De Paula, seconded by Councilmember Del Rio, to
  approve a donation of $3,000 to the Artesia High School Girls Soccer Team.

  The motion was carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 5; Del Rio, Roa, Vargas, De Paula, Farfan
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 0;
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 5–0–0–0

CLOSED SESSION

1.  CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS
  Pursuant to Government Code section 54957.6
  Agency­designated representative: Ernesto Marquez, City Manager
  Employee Organizations: AFSCME Local 3624 Rank & File Unit Union
  AFSCME Local 3624 Management Unit Union

John Natalizio, City Attorney, read the Closed Session Item into the record.

The City Council recessed to Closed Session at 6:37 PM

The City Council reconvened from Closed Session at 8:41 PM.

Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, conducted a roll call and announced a quorum.

John Natalizio, City Attorney, stated no reportable action from Closed Session.

ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting at 8:42 PM to the next Regular City Council meeting to be held
on Wednesday, March 27, 2024 at 6:00 PM
